rawResponse.notice: Market data notice: bars are served under the user's TradingView plan and exchange subscriptions (realtime where the user has the exchange data, otherwise delayed); the last bar is still forming and may change; regular session only; prices are split-adjusted only. summary.volume_unit_note: avg_volume / total_volume / last_bar_volume are in BASE units (shares for equities, base tokens for crypto).
